feed.title: Below the Surface

bullets: Reef conservation policy is a systems problem at planetary scale — the framing determines which tradeoffs are being made, and ignoring that leads to rebuilding the system from scratch a year later.
Most operational dive safety is about not pushing tired teams; the framing matters because it reveals which tradeoffs are in play.
Risk management on extended dives is mostly about exit planning — a pattern that holds across three different teams.
Adopting tools like GoPro or Suunto in a workflow makes the tradeoff visible, and the second-order effect is the part most people miss.
The failure mode in risk management crosscuts everything covered — the tradeoffs around it are where the conversation gets interesting.
A practical next step is to pick one idea covered and run it for two weeks — the rest is iteration.
